accuracy.datum_note: USGS F01-4 block (5 parallel flight lines, 248 images), no ground control. Positions are detector candidates confirmed visually by Claude from crops (targets/top4_sheet.png); IDs assigned by consistent shift (all three ~1 m W, 5-8 m N before the datum conversion); lead to re-confirm. SF15, SF19, SF20 (chalk marks) not identifiable at 5 cm; excluded. RTK checkpoints converted from NAD83(2011) (stated in the USGS metadata) to ITRF2020/WGS84 at epoch 2024.33 before comparison (about 1.5 m west and 0.6 m down at South Fork). The reference was converted; the map was not corrected.
accuracy.standard_note: ASPRS Positional Accuracy Standards Ed. 2 (2023) ask for at least 30 checkpoints for full compliance; this assessment uses 3.

vertical_relative.reference: USGS RTK ground (TOPO) points, ellipsoid heights, converted from NAD83(2011) to ITRF2020/WGS84
vertical_relative.method: DTM minus surveyed ground height; std after removing the mean offset (absolute heights are off by offset_m; heights relative to nearby ground are good to about std_m)

data_sources: USGS South Fork Campground debris-flow survey (public domain), doi:10.5066/P144KDGN
